The Volunteer State waded into the national fight over congressional lines this cycle after state lawmakers repealed a 56-year prohibition on mid-decade redistricting amid President Trump’s push for red states to boost...

new_points.title: Inside Trump's 'contentious' Oval Office meeting with Jeanine Pirro: Sources
new_points.content: Sources have described a meeting between President Trump and Jeanine Pirro over the Reflecting Pool as "contentious."

new_points.title: Farmer who hid lodger's body in concrete-filled barrel gets life for murder
new_points.content: A farmer and former butcher who murdered his lodger, dismembered his body and hid the remains in a concrete-filled barrel for six years, has been jailed.
